messages.content:
Chat sessions in Tasker aren't something I can reconnect to across restarts on my own — I don't have a mechanism to resume an old process/session; each turn spins up fresh and relies on the chat/task history stored on the board rather than an actual live connection being kept open. A few likely causes for what you're seeing:

- The extension or Tasker server restarted (e.g., VS Code reload, server stop/start), which drops any in-memory session state — only what's persisted to `.tasker/chats/<chatId>/` and `.tasker/roles/tasker/memory/chats/<chatId>.json` survives.
- You're pointing at a different/old chat id than the one currently active (this turn's active chat is `0d54c881`).
- The previous chat's task or agent process may have ended/finished, so there's no live agent to "reconnect" to — but its history should still be readable.

If you want, I can pull up the actual history of the previous chat so you at least have continuity of context, even if we can't "reconnect" a live session. Do you have the chat id, or should I look for recent chats on the board?
